summary: Verified backend regression and mobile onboarding/discovery flows against the public preview URL. Core flows passed; payment and admin boundaries correctly remain configuration-pending/protected.
action_items: Use a production-strength JWT_SECRET of at least 32 bytes before deployment; backend logs currently emit PyJWT InsecureKeyLengthWarning.
Keep Razorpay, FCM, and real SMS integrations behind their documented setup boundaries until credentials/providers are supplied.
critical_code_review_comments: The live app source has no LogBox global suppression; stale Metro cache artifacts still contain the prior ignoreAllLogs bundle and should be regenerated during normal release builds.
Backend source has development fallback secrets/config values; production deployment must provide environment variables rather than relying on defaults.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed authenticated profile through the existing regression/UI flows; no manual seed data was added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 390x844, welcome -> phone -> demo OTP 123456 -> permissions -> profile -> discovery passed. Radius displayed backend value 25 km. Like action advanced and Likes/Profile tabs rendered. Plans returned 200; checkout returned expected 503 pending; unauthenticated admin returned expected 503. Browser run's final error was a malformed test-side page.evaluate selector, not an app error. Expo logs only showed expected web notification support warning.
rca_of_issue: Initial pytest invocation lacked exported frontend environment variables, and the first browser script used an invalid mixed CSS/text selector; rerunning with .env exported and deterministic selectors passed the actual application flow. The only runtime warning found was PyJWT's short development secret warning. DEMO OTP is intentionally MOCKED/development mode; Razorpay, FCM, and real SMS delivery are provider boundaries pending credentials.
